purpose: Determine whether the immutable cross-fitted MS policy has real same-stack response value despite missing the pooled routing floor by 0.00067; this cannot convert the routing result to PASS.

sample.selection: four states per connected owner group by fixed hash order using protocol plus state_id; no label, prediction probability, response, or outcome stratification

isolated_policies.fixed_high_MS: MP0 MS1 ME0 RS0 whenever an actual Rank-1 exists
isolated_policies.cross_fitted_learned_MS: MP0, immutable OOF MS decision, ME0, RS0
isolated_policies.reason_RS_is_held_off: isolate memory responsibility; the separately passed RS head is evaluated on ESConv and combined only after MS feasibility

same_stack.realization: actual Rank-1 remains the frozen raw prior session, then one source-exact informative seeker span is selected outcome-blind using visible seeker text only; full raw session is never forced into the generator
same_stack.composition: MS is a tentative continuity bridge inside one response plan; it is not an appended sentence and not an unconditional fact about the present
same_stack.adapter: all policies use the same memory-realization and joint-composition candidate contract
same_stack.forbidden: post-hoc retrieval text appended to an already generated response
same_stack.generator_model_prompt_seed_guard: identical across policies except the authorized MS bit and bound resource
same_stack.deduplication_rule: for each state, learned aliases always-off or fixed-high because its immutable OOF decision is binary; generate each distinct state-action-seed once and retain all policy aliases

measurement.quality: blind paired win/tie/loss with concrete anchors; no 1-5 scale and no training-label role
measurement.risk: six explicit literal event families, each yes/no plus severity and exact response span; verbosity or low helpfulness is not risk
measurement.function: requested resource appeared materially, changed the response in a source-grounded way, and respected owner/time/boundary; exact evidence spans required
measurement.cost: injected context, provider input/output tokens, latency, and USD reported separately
measurement.independent_overlap: at least 20% plus every material-risk event
measurement.LLM_judge: sensitivity only; disagreement never overwrites human primary and never changes PM labels
measurement.aggregation: paired owner-cluster estimates and intervals; raw win/tie/loss and event counts retained

feasibility_success: learned versus always-off quality is not directionally worse and predicted-ON strata show positive function or quality signal
learned versus fixed-high materially reduces injected context
learned does not increase material risk versus either comparator
requested-to-materially-used accounting is complete and generator failures remain assigned to Step2 rather than relabeled as PM errors
decision.interpretation_if_success: directionally usable frozen MS policy; still not a formal routing-head PASS and not yet a paper confirmation
decision.interpretation_if_failure: terminate the memory PM claim; no new label, model, threshold, or reviewer loop
